narrative_functions.name: HOOK
narrative_functions.description: Captures initial attention, disrupts scrolling feed, and creates immediate curiosity or emotional self-identification.

narrative_functions.name: PAIN
narrative_functions.description: Explores daily friction, suffering, spatial constraint, or emotional frustration experienced by the prospect.

narrative_functions.name: PROMISE
narrative_functions.description: Introduces the core possibility, transformation, or alternative available to the buyer.

narrative_functions.name: REVEAL
narrative_functions.description: Formal visual/narrative materialization of the person, product, development, key space, or solution that was set up previously.
narrative_functions.core_intent: Payoff of curiosity and physical grounding of the offer

narrative_functions.name: EXPLANATION
narrative_functions.description: Breaks down how the opportunity, mechanism, financing, or physical layout works.
narrative_functions.core_intent: Cognitive comprehension and elimination of confusion

narrative_functions.name: PROOF
narrative_functions.description: Demonstrates tangible factual evidence, specifications, real footage, or documentation validating previous claims.
narrative_functions.core_intent: Validation of truth and risk reduction

narrative_functions.name: DEMONSTRATION
narrative_functions.description: Shows how the space, room, feature, or amenities are experienced in real life.

narrative_functions.name: DESIRE
narrative_functions.description: Evokes aspirational lifestyle, leisure, aesthetic delight, and emotional attachment to the property.

narrative_functions.name: VALUE
narrative_functions.description: Highlights the cost-benefit ratio, appreciation potential, luxury-to-price balance, or unique advantages.

narrative_functions.name: AUTHORITY
narrative_functions.description: Demonstrates market expertise, institutional security, construction track record, or professional credibility.

narrative_functions.name: OBJECTION
narrative_functions.description: Directly tackles, dismantles, and resolves major buyer hesitations (financial, geographical, bureaucratic).

narrative_functions.name: OFFER
narrative_functions.description: Articulates the specific commercial proposal, entry conditions, price point, financing program, or availability.

narrative_functions.name: CTA
narrative_functions.description: Directs the prospect toward a single, frictionless, immediate next action (button, link, message, scheduling).

viewer_effects.name: curiosity
viewer_effects.description: Desire to keep watching to discover what happens or how a promise is fulfilled.

viewer_effects.name: identification
viewer_effects.description: Feeling of "this person understands my reality and speaks to me".

viewer_effects.name: understanding
viewer_effects.description: Clear mental comprehension of how an offer, space, or process operates.

viewer_effects.name: belief
viewer_effects.description: Cognitive acceptance that a claim is authentic, factual, and attainable.

viewer_effects.name: trust
viewer_effects.description: Emotional security and confidence in the presenter, developer, or agency.

viewer_effects.name: desire
viewer_effects.description: Aspirational longing to inhabit the space or own the lifestyle portrayed.

viewer_effects.name: surprise
viewer_effects.description: Unexpected revelation or pleasant counter-intuitive insight.

viewer_effects.name: relief
viewer_effects.description: Alleviation of financial anxiety, spatial frustration, or bureaucratic fear.

viewer_effects.name: urgency
viewer_effects.description: Recognition of limited opportunity or timing advantage requiring action.

viewer_effects.name: value_perception
viewer_effects.description: Recognition that the property delivers immense value relative to its cost.

viewer_effects.name: spatial_understanding
viewer_effects.description: Mental 3D map of floorplan flow, room dimensions, and integration.

viewer_effects.name: memorability
viewer_effects.description: Key figures, unique amenities, or emotional phrases retained in memory.

viewer_effects.name: action_readiness
viewer_effects.description: Preparedness to tap the screen, send a lead, or book a site visit.

viewer_effects.name: anticipation_payoff
viewer_effects.description: Pleasurable fulfillment of a setup or curiosity gap previously built.

viewer_effects.name: orientation
viewer_effects.description: Clear grounding in where we are geographically, physically, and narratively.

viewer_effects.name: curiosity_resolution
viewer_effects.description: Resolution of an open question posed earlier in the video.

editorial_needs.name: HUMAN_CONNECTION
editorial_needs.description: Establishing, sustaining, or re-anchoring direct personal empathy, trust, and eye contact with the viewer.

editorial_needs.name: VISUAL_PROOF
editorial_needs.description: Providing authentic visual materialization of a spoken claim, physical space, or tangible spec.

editorial_needs.name: SPATIAL_CLARITY
editorial_needs.description: Conveying physical layout, room proportions, flow, and three-dimensional architectural relationships.

editorial_needs.name: INFORMATION_CLARITY
editorial_needs.description: Ensuring complex numbers, financing terms, locations, or rules are effortlessly understood.

editorial_needs.name: EMPHASIS
editorial_needs.description: Visually and acoustically accentuating a pivotal moment, price anchor, or game-changing benefit.

editorial_needs.name: ATMOSPHERE
editorial_needs.description: Building sensory mood, cozy lighting, aspirational elegance, and emotional warmth.

editorial_needs.name: NOVELTY
editorial_needs.description: Introducing sensory refresh, scale shift, or visual disruption to prevent feed drop-off.

editorial_needs.name: CONTINUITY
editorial_needs.description: Maintaining unbroken flow, narrative focus, and logical sequence across thoughts.

editorial_needs.name: CONTEXT
editorial_needs.description: Grounding the property in its wider geographical, urban, neighborhood, or market setting.

editorial_needs.name: ACTION_CLARITY
editorial_needs.description: Making the immediate next conversion step unmistakable, friction-free, and inviting.

editorial_needs.name: VISUAL_PAYOFF
editorial_needs.description: Delivering the visual satisfaction of seeing what was teased or promised in earlier moments.

editorial_needs.name: PERFORMANCE_PRESERVATION
editorial_needs.description: Protecting an exceptionally strong, emotive, or comedic presenter delivery without cutting prematurely.

editorial_needs.name: AESTHETIC_BREATHING
editorial_needs.description: Allowing visually stunning property frames to be contemplated without rushed cutting.

narrative_arc_states.name: setup
narrative_arc_states.description: Establishing premise, context, pain point, or initial curiosity hook.

narrative_arc_states.name: tension
narrative_arc_states.description: Heightening awareness of the problem, friction, or urgency.

narrative_arc_states.name: development
narrative_arc_states.description: Elaborating arguments, lifestyle opportunities, and product capabilities.

narrative_arc_states.name: proof
narrative_arc_states.description: Validating claims through footage, numbers, specs, and architectural evidence.

narrative_arc_states.name: reveal
narrative_arc_states.description: Pivotal unveiling of the property, price, or core breakthrough.

narrative_arc_states.name: payoff
narrative_arc_states.description: Delivering visual/emotional gratification and aspirational lifestyle reward.

narrative_arc_states.name: transition
narrative_arc_states.description: Pivoting from product exploration to commercial terms or closing.

narrative_arc_states.name: conversion
narrative_arc_states.description: Direct closing call to action and next steps guidance.

mappings.rationale: Grammar interprets what the sentence is trying to achieve (Narrative Function + Viewer Effect) before seeking visual solutions.
Before cutting, the system asks whether an editorial reason exists to change the screen state, preventing timer-based cutting.
Categorizing beats into SUPPORTING, MEANINGFUL, MAJOR, and HERO dictates emphasis intensity.
Decoupling what is mentioned (Subject) from how it is framed (Function) stops naive keyword substring cutting.
Presenter presence is recognized as a narrative asset, ensuring the human guide conducts the arc.
